summary.text: Kyler Sweely is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 102 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kyler Sweely served in the United States Army from 2017 to 2022.
Sweely won the November 5, 2024 general election for Kansas House District 102, defeating incumbent Jason Probst, and took office on January 13, 2025.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Higher Education Budget Committee, the Financial Institutions and Pensions Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
